entries.what: Bancroft (1999) UWA BEng thesis 'Performance Monitoring of the Cable Station Artificial Surfing Reef' (as-built levels, monitoring)
entries.where: papers/ folder (pymupdf grep 'Bancroft'); web search 'Bancroft 1999 UWA thesis Cable Station artificial surfing reef'
entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.detail: papers/ has only two citations of it (Review of artificial reefs for coastal protection in NSW 2013). Web search returns secondary summaries and no repository record or full text.
entries.might_work: UWA Library catalogue / UWA Centre for Water Research archive via Lior or an e-mail to the library; check Blacka et al. 2013 reference list for the call number.

entries.what: Ranasinghe et al. (2001) Cable Station reef design study
entries.where: papers/ folder (grep 'Ranasinghe', hits in Rendle thesis, NSW review 2013, Narrowneck 2023 are all citations); web search 'Ranasinghe Turner Symonds 2001 artificial surfing reef Cable Station'
entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.detail: The only hits are citations; the Ranasinghe, Turner and Symonds item that exists is the 2006 Coastal Engineering paper on shoreline response (different paper). No 2001 record found.
entries.might_work: Check Blacka (2013) reference list for the exact 2001 item; Lior via a university library.

entries.what: Pattiaratchi (2003) 'Performance of an artificial surfing reef: Cable Station, Western Australia', COPEDEC VI, Colombo
entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.detail: Both returned HTTP 403 to a plain curl request; no login or bot check was attempted around. papers/ only cites it (Rendle thesis p.293; NSW review 2013).
entries.might_work: Lior via browser (ResearchGate download or UWA repository), or the COPEDEC VI proceedings.

entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.detail: Citation taken from Mead and Borrero 2011 (papers/, ref [13]); the PDF was not reachable. Possible source of as-built description and monitoring.

entries.what: Higher-resolution RWR design drawings Cables-Design.jpg and Cables-Additional-Fill-Area.jpg
entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.detail: Downloaded again: 478 x 339 and 417 x 296 px, SHA-256 identical to the registered img-05 and img-06. The RWR site has no larger version.
entries.might_work: Request the drawings from Raised Water Research / the UWA CWR (e-mail by Lior).

entries.what: Transport WA tide-data pages (Fremantle Fishing Boat Harbour, Fremantle Railway Bridge, Perth) for LAT / AHD / chart-datum relation
entries.where: https://www.transport.wa.gov.au/marine/charts-warnings-current-conditions/coastal-data-charts/tide-data/<station> (curl; WebFetch gives ENOTFOUND for this host)
entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.result: other: page has no datum text
entries.detail: Pages are script-rendered; the fetched HTML contains no datum, LAT, MSL or AHD statement. Transport WA states heights as 'metres to LWM Fremantle Fishing Boat Harbour' (search snippet) without the AHD offset.
entries.might_work: Transport WA Coastal Information (Tides@transport.wa.gov.au, named in the DoT bathymetry readme) for the Fremantle CD-AHD offset and HAT/LAT; the Australian National Tide Tables.

entries.what: BoM NTC Fremantle metadata sheet 62230 (Corkhill Landing gauge)
entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.detail: Gives only 'Fremantle Low Water Datum (LWD) = CD' as vertical reference and TGBM Fremantle 53A at 3.088 m above CD; no AHD or LAT offset. Used as a reference for the datum name; the missing offset is the dead end.
entries.might_work: Fremantle Ports hydrographer (named on the sheet) or Transport WA.

entries.what: Perth Metro LiDAR (Landgate) as a seabed source
entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.result: other: land only, ad hoc paid extract
entries.detail: Captured 2021-22 over built-up areas; not bathymetric and not downloadable.
entries.might_work: Not useful for the seabed; DoT WA Bathymetry (used) is.

entries.what: Esri Wayback releases before 2014-12 at zoom 19 around the reef
entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.detail: Tiles missing at z19 for the two earliest releases (z17 tiles exist); capture dates of Wayback tiles are not returned by the metadata layer for most releases ('unknown').
entries.might_work: Google Earth Pro historical imagery (Lior) for dated 1999-2010 imagery; Nearmap/Landgate historic aerials (login or fee).

entries.what: Surf-forecast / design-study coordinates for the reef ('32 00 S 115 45 E', surf-forecast 32.00 S 115.74 E)
entries.where: web search 'Cables Reef coordinates latitude longitude Cable Station'
entries.by: agent: Cables with imagery and bathymetry (cloud)
entries.detail: Rounded coordinates point about 1.7 km north of the reef (reef anchor -32.0156, 115.7485, found from the DoT soundings and imagery); the task's search box -32.01..-31.99 missed it.
